label: Wall Features
notes: Strong facade-detail candidate; likely complementary to cladding, style, and form.

label: Landscape Features
notes: Context task; useful for setting, category, and broader site interpretation.

label: Window
notes: Promising but visually smaller/noisier than entrance; needs grouping.

label: Entrance
notes: Promising if grouped around broad entrance type and location.

label: Associated Buildings and Objects
notes: Context/object task; depends strongly on image angle and full-view coverage.

label: Building Category
notes: Broad auxiliary classifier; useful if enough non-residential examples exist.

label: Current Use
notes: Broad use categories may be visual; fine-grained use is context-heavy.

label: Roof Materials
notes: Often dominated by asphalt/unknown and hard to verify from street-level photos.

label: Original Use
notes: Historical field; weak image-only target despite high label coverage.

label: Roof Features
notes: Conceptually useful, but many atomics are expected to be sparse.

label: Building Plan
notes: Usually needs aerial or multi-view information; front facade is often insufficient.

label: Additional Cladding
notes: Secondary material task; likely sparse and better deferred unless counts surprise.
